row.notes: New row. Procreate (Savage Interactive) is an iPad drawing app (plus Procreate Dreams and Procreate Pocket) sold only as a one-off App Store purchase with no subscription; procreate.com shows no price and no team, business or enterprise plan. Organisations distribute it through Apple School Manager (50% education discount, bulk options for classrooms), i.e. Apple volume purchasing and device management, not a Procreate admin console. There are no Procreate organisation accounts, so no SSO, SCIM or user-management API exists; the help centre, education site and procreate.com sitemap mention none. App Store list prices are not cited because they are on Apple's store, not a Procreate page. Status none by absence; team_plan null because there is no multi-user paid tier.
